title: Karuppu Nila
desc: After his father is falsely accused of aiding terrorists, Shanmuga Pandian's girlfriend leaves him. However, he joins forces with Nandhini and battles against all odds to clear his father's name.

title: Raja Mariyadhai
desc: Raghuram, working for an authoritarian man Rajasekar, attempts to conceal his marriage as his boss is opposed to the concept of marriage.

title: Ellam Inbamayam
desc: Pazhani and Velu, two innocent villagers, move to the city to earn a living. When Velu's employer cheats him, Pazhani helps him take revenge.

title: Kadhal Devathai
desc: Raju, a caretaker of four orphaned children, is elated when he finds a magical ring in the Himalayas. On the other hand, Indraja, the daughter of Lord Indra, lands on Earth to retrieve her lost ring.

title: Azhagarsamy
desc: Thayama gets money from a landlord in order to save her husband and promises to give her child in return. Things turn for the worst when the rich man wants to marry off his daughter to Thayama's son.
